app.title: TypeStax: A type scale generator with vintage audio hardware interface
app.author: jasim
proposed_tests: Connect a vintage audio device and test latency.
Generate a type scale using the UI and evaluate result precision.
Measure processing time for a single operation.
Test API endpoints for stability and throughput.
